name: cookie-declaration
title: Cookie declaration
description: The full list of cookies and similar storage by category, with provider, purpose, lifetime and type, to sit behind your banner.
docs: List every cookie and similar storage by category, and keep empty categories: they say None. Write durations in words, such as Session or 13 months. consent is a slot for the visitor's consent id and your Change my choice button, because that needs your consent tool. Below 768px each table becomes stacked cards with the same five labels. Pass labels to translate the column heads.
